chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Bābawayh, from Muḥassin ibn Aḥmad, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the prayer over a woman: is the husband more entitled to her, or the brother? He said: the brother.

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled or having greater right of precedence
key_terms.الزَّوْجُ: the husband, mentioned as one possible claimant of priority
key_terms.الْأَخُ: the brother, identified as having priority
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the deceased woman over whom the prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: Who is more entitled to lead the funeral prayer over a woman in Shia hadith: her husband or her brother?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding who has greater entitlement in the funeral prayer over a woman. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that her brother has more right than her husband in this matter, indicating an order of precedence among relatives.
